entries.title: Track anime, manga, and games
entries.description: You can search for titles, add them to your library, and track your status and progress. Your library updates can appear in the feed.

entries.title: Make your profile your own
entries.description: You can upload an avatar, cover photo, and wallpaper, visit other members’ profiles, and post on profile walls. Your account preferences now have a dedicated settings page.

entries.title: Give your community a new look
entries.description: You can personalize communities you manage with an icon, cover photo, and background image. Image menus on avatars and headers make changes easier.

entries.title: Notifications and feedback tracking
entries.description: You can keep up with comment, friend, and report updates in your notifications. You can also submit bugs or ideas and follow your tickets.

entries.title: Invite people to your community
entries.description: You can share community invite links, including links with an expiry date or a limit on how many people can use them.

entries.title: Like posts and discuss library updates
entries.description: You can like posts and library activity, comment on activity, and read comment previews directly in the feed.

entries.title: Talk about your favorite titles
entries.description: You can post on anime, manga, and game pages and see other people tracking the same title.

entries.title: Group your communities into folders
entries.description: You can drag communities together in the sidebar to organize them into folders.

entries.title: Get help getting started
entries.description: You can follow a welcome tour and a checklist to find your way around Orbis.

entries.title: Read the community rules and policies
entries.description: You can now find the community guidelines, privacy policy, and terms from the site footer.

entries.title: See who’s in your community
entries.description: You can browse a dedicated members tab and see online members in the side panel.

entries.title: Your library remembers your view
entries.description: You can switch between library views and title types, and your choices are remembered when you return. Search is now in the library header.

entries.title: Clearer feeds and page layouts
entries.description: You’ll see loading placeholders, a marker when you reach the end of a feed, clearer badges, and simpler wording across the site. New accounts start with the dark theme.

entries.title: A richer welcome page
entries.description: You can preview Orbis features on the redesigned welcome page. Shared links also have a branded image and description.
